rationale.overall: B’s sharper, more tactile surface treatment comes marginally closer to the reference’s grounded physical read.
rationale.material: B has slightly stronger microtexture and surface contrast, though both takes render the dark object smoother and glossier than the reference.
rationale.silhouette: The object, loop, and rounded-square framing silhouettes appear effectively identical in A and B.
rationale.smallsize: Both takes reduce to the same clear dark-bar, pale-loop, and orange-edge read at 128px, 32px, and 16px.
